pages.title: Castillon
pages.description: commune in Alpes-Maritimes, France
pages.extract: Castillon is a pleasant perched village on the road from Menton to Sospel and thence Breil sur Roya.

pages.title: Coiba National Marine Park
pages.description: island and national park in Panama
pages.extract: Coiba National Marine Park (Parque Nacional Coiba) is a park in the Gulf of Chiriqui in the Pacific West of Panama that is frequently called the "Galapagos Islands of Central America" for its abundance of rare species in the water and on land.  Coiba is known for its superior diving.

pages.title: Diving the Cape Peninsula and False Bay/Blue Rock Quarry
pages.description: inland dive site in Gordon's Bay at the foot of Sir Lowry's Pass
pages.extract: The dive site Blue Rock Quarry is a flooded quarry. It is the only significant fresh water dive site with public access in the greater metropolitan area of Cape Town in the Western Cape province of South Africa.

pages.title: Eastern Virginia
pages.extract: Eastern Virginia is an often-visited area of Virginia, bordered on the west by the Fall Line, and on the east by the Chesapeake Bay and Atlantic Ocean. It is best known for its beaches and colonial history.

pages.title: Hamilton (Victoria)
pages.description: city in Victoria, Australia
pages.extract: Hamilton is a town in western Victoria, Australia.

pages.title: Havelian
pages.description: municipality in the Abbottabad District in Pakistan
pages.extract: Havelian is a town in Hazara Region of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It is situated north of Islamabad at a distance of 110 KM on Silk route (Karakorum Highway), 12 KM short of Abbottabad, lying at the foot hills of Himalayas. The town is a hub of Hazara culture and traditions. Havelian literally means “The Mansions” which corresponds to the old residential Mansions and caravan-serai hosting the ancient caravans traveling along the silk route. Havelain experiences mild summers followed by rainy showers leaving behind velvet like grass carpet covering the hills. In winters, the valley is set against the background of snow covered mountains of Galiat.

pages.title: Holyoke
pages.description: city in Hampden County, Massachusetts, United States
pages.extract: Holyoke is a city in the Pioneer Valley in Massachusetts. It is a former mill city, which made a large chunk of the world's paper. It has interesting architecture and is close to many attractions. It contains the Volleyball Hall of Fame and some of the largest former paper mills. If  you visit, there are a number of things here and close by to entertain you.

pages.title: Ellmau
pages.description: municipality in Kufstein District, Tyrol, Austria
pages.extract: Ellmau (population just under 3,000 in 2024) is a small village in the heart of the Wilder Kaiser mountains in Northeast Tyrol. Visitors can travel to the top of Hartkaiser mountain via the Hartkaiserbahn funicular, the only of its type in the Ski Welt. The municipality is located in a summer and winter sports area and lives mainly from tourism ( 5000 guest beds).

pages.title: Kurjenrahka National Park
pages.description: national park in Finland Proper region, Finland
pages.extract: Kurjenrahka National Park in Finland, in Finland Proper, is centred around the raised bog Kurjenrahka ("Crane bog"). Besides bogs and birdlife it features lakes and forests, among them the old-growth Pukkipalo. A large trail network, named after the old border stone Kuhankuono in Kurjenrahka, connects the park with Vaskijärvi nature reserve and centres of Turku, Yläne and other municipalities in the vicinity.

pages.title: Dong Van Karst Plateau Geopark
pages.description: geopark in northern Vietnam
pages.extract: Dong Van Karst Plateau Geopark is in Tuyên Quang Province in the northernmost part of Vietnam, along the border with China. This UNESCO Global Geopark showcases the area's rugged landscape and the diversity of its inhabitants. The Ha Giang Loop, an iconic motorcycle itinerary, winds its way through the park.

pages.title: Côte-d'Or
pages.description: French department
pages.extract: Côte-d'Or is a department in Bourgogne-Franche-Comté, rich in history and heritage. It is known for its Romanesque and Gothic art, and its cuisine and lifestyle.

pages.title: Deltona
pages.description: city in Volusia County, Florida, United States
pages.extract: Deltona is a city in Volusia County. With a population of 93,000 in 2019, it's near DeLand and southwest of the Daytona Beach metropolitan area.

pages.title: Glenridding
pages.description: village in Cumbria, England, UK
pages.extract: Glenridding is a village at the southern end of Ullswater, in the English Lake District. The village is popular with mountain walkers who can scale England's third-highest mountain, Helvellyn, and many other challenging peaks from there.

pages.title: Lake Turkana
pages.description: alkaline lake on the border of Ethiopia and Kenya
pages.extract: As you crawl forward in your 4x4, the so-called Jade Sea emerges before you. A vast, deep-green oasis in an otherwise barren hellscape. But this is not your storybook oasis. The water is undrinkable. The wind unrelenting. And basks of crocodiles eye you warily from the shore. Welcome to the world's largest desert lake, Lake Turkana.

pages.title: Cala d'Or
pages.description: settlement (pedanía) in Santanyí, Mallorca, Spain
pages.extract: Cala d'Or is the main coastal resort in Migjorn de Mallorca, the southern region of that island, with a population in 2024 of 4100. It was built from the 1930s around three sea inlets: Cala Gran central, Cala Egos to the west and Cala Ferrera to the east.
